chunks: It is narrated from Yūnus ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I complained to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who was harming me, so he said, "Pray against him." I said, "I have already prayed against him." He said, "Not like that. Rather, cease from sins, fast, pray, and give charity. Then, when it is the end of the night, perform the wudu (ablution) thoroughly, then stand and pray two rakʿahs. Then say while you are in sajdah (prostration): O Allah, indeed so-and-so son of so-and-so has harmed me. O Allah, make his body ill, cut off his trace, diminish his lifespan, and hasten that for him in this very year."
He said: So I did that, and it was not long before he perished.

key_terms.آخِرُ اللَّيْلِ: The last part of the night, a specified time for the supplication
key_terms.الذُّنُوبِ: Sins from which one must desist before making this du'a
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: Wudu (ablution) to be performed thoroughly before the prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: Two units of salat (prayer) to be offered before the supplication
key_terms.سَاجِدٌ: In the state of sajdah (prostration), where the du'a is to be recited
key_terms.صُمْ: Observe sawm (fasting) as part of spiritual preparation

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach a believer to make du'a against someone who was harming him?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a taught du'a for seeking relief from someone who is causing harm. It emphasizes spiritual preparation through avoiding sins, sawm (fasting), salat (prayer), charity, and a night-time act of supplication in sajdah before asking Allah against an oppressor.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I complained to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who was harming me.
Imam (as) said: "Pray against him."
I replied: "I have already prayed against him."
Imam (as) said: "Not like that. Instead, refrain from sins, fast, pray, and give charity. Then, in the last part of the night, perform ablution thoroughly, stand up and pray two units (rak'ahs). While in prostration, say:
'O’ Allah (swt), so-and-so (mention his name) has harmed me. O’ Allah (swt), weaken his body, cut off his influence, shorten his lifespan, and hasten this upon him this year.'"
He said: I did so, and it wasn't long before he perished.
